acceptance_test_interpretation: AT01 must demonstrate that target text, state, identifiers, passive signatures, and action priors cannot solve A1-A4 or collapse counterfactual twins; the oracle/shuffle tests establish that lived action-outcome bindings, rather than surface cues, are necessary. AT02 and AT08 operationalize admissible local experiential structure: atoms, relations, exceptions, and bounded shortcuts need witnessed roots, chronology, lifecycle, and acyclic provenance, while answer-bearing or self-supported material is rejected. AT03 and AT09 ensure fixed-deck comparisons measure use of assigned frozen memory rather than evaluation learning, scorer feedback, agenda laundering, cached history, or cross-life contamination. AT04 requires every mandatory arm and ledger so an absent or non-comparable baseline cannot be interpreted favorably. AT05 must separately show A1 transfer, A2 cross-episode construction, A3 multi-dependency planning, and A4 exception-driven revision; A0 is installation-only, and four-to-six-action goals plus shortcut collision checks prevent a local shortcut from being a stored solution. AT06 is the sole test for a causal experiential flywheel: hash-matched clones, randomized assigned memory, matched budgets, sealed branch outcomes, and independent decks distinguish changed future experience from fixed-deck memory use. AT07 is a pre-GPU artifact-binding gate, not behavioral evidence. AT10 must hold accepted semantic bytes, common reader, candidate universe, query policy, and thinker budget fixed across P5T/P5L/P5S and common-interface graph comparisons; P3N is a separately labeled native-interface comparison, and P5A/P5S isolate shortcut materialization. AT11 binds the 24 locked world-life confirmation, paired estimands, onset rule, missing cells, multiplicity, and null-result dispositions, preventing post-hoc selection of a favorable lifetime or family. AT12 establishes reproducible fail-closed execution and prevents parser/resume artifacts from substituting for cognitive behavior.

ambiguities.impact: The external roster rule is specified, but no selected external benchmark is yet established; external-development wording remains unavailable unless the frozen fit gate succeeds.
ambiguities.question: Will the ratified scope include only the controlled-world pilot if both DiscoveryWorld and ScienceWorld fail their prescribed CPU gate?

ambiguities.impact: Active versus retained bytes and training/query/think compute are to be reported separately, but the proposal does not define a single equality rule for every unequal-capacity comparison; interpretation must remain limited to the declared ledger and labeled interfaces.
ambiguities.question: Which resource dimension, if any, will be used as the formal fixed-memory comparison basis for headline substrate language beyond the required reporting ledger?

ambiguities.impact: The negative-result table says lack of recurrent-sleep advantage rejects cadence, but the mandatory-arm list does not name a concrete final-batch-only arm or its matching schedule.
ambiguities.question: Will the exact ratified implementation register the final-batch counterpart and matching compute/corpus conditions needed to test recurrence cadence?

ambiguities.impact: Checkpoints and a 24-life confirmation are specified, but a positive 8C primary result does not by itself establish continued improvement through 16C or baseline flattening across all arms.
ambiguities.question: What exact evidentiary threshold will distinguish the bounded 8C behavioral claim from any stronger continued-improvement or saturation language?

assumptions: The controlled-world generator can enforce paired-world shared surface signatures and different correct actions without exposing a target-correlated residual feature to the common reader.
Ordinary public outcomes, unlike held-out evaluation and clone outcomes, are the only future observations eligible to support within-life semantic revision.
All common-interface arms receive the same public candidate universe and frozen resolver policy, so candidate recognition is not itself a substrate-specific advantage.
The text and LoRA corpus realizations can be made semantically identical while their retained and active resource costs are reported rather than silently equated.
A1-A4 decks are generated independently of per-arm memory and contain no stored complete solution, including through a sequence of individually legal shortcuts.
A positive fixed-deck result is interpreted as assigned-memory use only; online learning requires the separate randomized clone intervention.
claim_delta_interpretation: C0 is protocol fidelity only. C1 requires the locked, post-context 8C paired behavioral contrast and developmental contrast; it is not established by recall, A0, a short-life result, or a fixed-deck gain alone. C2 requires P5S over matched direct/raw P4 and therefore credits useful compiler-produced supported structure, not merely LoRA retention. C3 additionally requires P5S over separately labeled fair native graph P3N under the common reader and resource ledger; P5S over P4 but not P3N supports no parametric-substrate conclusion. C4 requires valid randomized memory assignment in sealed cloned continuations and is not implied by fixed-deck success. C5 correctly partitions adverse outcomes: shuffle/cross-life survival indicates leakage or generic effects; A0/A1-only gains are retention/transfer; no P5S>P4 rejects compiler increment; no P5S>P3N rejects substrate advantage; no recurrence advantage rejects cadence; and external fit failure removes external-development language.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep headline language bounded to the declared 8C endpoint and report, without extrapolation, the full checkpoint curve and 16C cells.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A geometric curve enables investigation of onset and persistence, but the primary contrast at 8C cannot alone demonstrate indefinite continued improvement or that all strong baselines have flattened.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal's developmental framing may be read more broadly than its primary 8C confirmation endpoint identifies.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before ratification, bind a final-batch-only comparator with the same accepted corpus, total compiler/training compute, reader, and evaluation checkpoints, or remove cadence conclusions from the negative-result table.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A claimed recurrence-removal result needs an explicitly instantiated arm; otherwise failure of a non-specified comparison cannot be evidentially interpreted.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal disposes of no recurrent-sleep advantage but does not explicitly include the required final-batch ablation among named arms.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: State comparisons as ledger-conditioned unless the ratified protocol specifies which active/retained byte measure is matched and how token/compute trade-offs are constrained.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Equal semantic corpus, reader policy, and reported ledgers reduce confounding, but text, graph, and LoRA have intrinsically different active and retained representations.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal's resource reporting does not by itself force a universal fixed-memory equality condition across substrates.

graph_delta_interpretation: The organism is an intentionally separated causal pipeline: only public actions and later ordinary outcomes produce primary evidence; wake creates bounded branch state and at most selection-only agendas; dream locally proposes supported relations, exceptions, procedures, and bounded shortcuts; semantic status/provenance validates them; compiler creates auditable re-expressions; a cumulative per-life LoRA transports those associations; and later wake receives only bounded local reads to construct a goal-conditioned path. Evaluation, scoring, audit, and clone outcomes are explicitly outside cognition. This graph supports a local-edge accumulation account rather than requiring dream to solve global goals: later wake composes several local reads only when a new goal demands them. The benchmark must verify that the public candidate universe and reader cannot convert that intended path into target recognition, raw-store retrieval, or an answer-prior shortcut.

open_questions: Whether Rohin ratifies the exact proposal bytes and implementation scope, including the controlled-world generator, fallback disposition, model/budget/rank/split/baseline rules, visibility contract, tests, and claim boundary.
Whether the unresolved recurrence-control and fixed-memory-comparison details are repaired in the ratified bytes or excluded from claimed conclusions.

loop_delta_interpretation: Temporal order is essential: action-conditioned observation and ordinary outcome precede immutable episodic evidence; sleep occurs only at geometric checkpoints on prior ordinary evidence, released paths, and selection-only agendas; semantic validation and compilation precede cumulative rebuild of the per-life adapter from theta_0; only a later goal mounts that checkpoint and invokes bounded reads plus explicit reconstruction; its ordinary outcome can affect a future sleep cycle. Fixed-deck evaluation freezes and isolates that loop, so it measures representation/use under common experience rather than learning from evaluation. The clone loop is later and distinct: a replayed canonical prefix is cloned, memory is randomized at the branch boundary, continuation outcomes are sealed, and independent read-only evaluation follows. Thus fixed-deck action improvement, memory transport, composition, and an on-policy feedback effect cannot be conflated.
system_thesis_interpretation: The proposed full organism is not a LoRA-only learner. A frozen base theta_0 and frozen controller phi repeatedly convert a life’s own action-conditioned history into an auditable per-life semantic approximation psi_l: wake retrieves and explicitly reconstructs local dependencies for a current goal; sleep proposes and validates local experience-grounded connections; compilation provides a lossy parametric transport surface; later wake turns bounded associations plus cited exact evidence into planning, revision, and action. The intended behavioral test is useful only if the game makes the causal history necessary after it exceeds context/read capacity, requires multi-step construction from locally stored pieces, and prevents standard agent priors, raw context, RAG, explicit graph access, or target-correlated public signatures from bypassing that temporal path.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix establishes the critical anti-shortcut contract: public lived evidence is visible during life; semantic records and corpus/adapter content are available to wake only as bounded derived reader results; raw semantic traversal, unrestricted episodic search, agenda-as-evidence, workspace residue, evaluator outcomes, hidden truth, scorer output, and audit receipts are prohibited at cognitive stages. Dream may use public roots, eligible semantic state, released paths, and typed agendas, but not raw unsupported workspace or future/evaluation data. Checkpoint training admits only accepted corpus realizations; scorer truth becomes visible only after commitment. Benchmark fixtures must treat any availability through prompts, caches, candidate construction, process state, logs, or reader receipts as a violation, even if no explicit graph edge permits it.
